quotes.quote: Long-acting injectables (LAIs) for OUD are prescription medications administered by a healthcare professional that deliver medication continuously over a defined period of time. This steady delivery can help reduce cravings, minimize the risk of withdrawal, and support consistent recovery progress.

LAIs for OUD are backed by years of scientific research and clinical evidence. They are approved by health authorities and shown to be both safe and effective when used as prescribed under the supervision of a qualified healthcare provider.
